name: catalog-explorer-assessment
description: Catalog Explorer backend assessment: NestJS gRPC CatalogService + thin HTTP edge over the Open Library API.

scripts.proto:gen: mkdir -p src/proto/gen && protoc --plugin=./node_modules/.bin/protoc-gen-ts_proto --ts_proto_out=src/proto/gen --ts_proto_opt=nestJs=true,outputServices=grpc-js,env=node,useOptionals=messages -I proto proto/catalog.proto proto/health.proto
